one_line: 芝加哥艺术博物馆藏织绣，馆方断代作「1900/10, Qing dynasty (1644–1911)」。**本条为著录级**：照录馆方记录，未作阐释。

rows: Silk, plain weave with discontinuous wefts; painted details
Gift of Mrs. Edgar J. Stone

basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录芝加哥艺术博物馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → qing；器类归入依据仅为：type=Costume and Accessories + medium 含织物材料。

dating.text: 馆方给出了年代，**但未在公开记录中说明这个年代依据什么**——是铭文、器形序列、共出器物还是风格比对，无从得知。本库的断代十档因此无法填写：**填任何一档都是替馆方作了它没作的声明。**

provenance.title: Art Institute of Chicago, Elizabeth F. Cheney and Agnes Allerton Textile Galleries, Clothed to Rule the Universe: Ming and Qing Dynasty Textiles at The Art Inst
provenance.text: Art Institute of Chicago, Elizabeth F. Cheney and Agnes Allerton Textile Galleries, Clothed to Rule the Universe: Ming and Qing Dynasty Textiles at The Art Institute of Chicago, Sept. 13, 2000–Jan. 2, 2001, cat. 69.
